repair_1.review_finding: F1 MEDIUM blocking -- SINGLE_SOURCE_VALIDATION's requested source did not constrain evaluation
repair_1.option_b_considered_and_rejected_because: Option B would delete the mode and the requested source entirely, which would have removed a lawful narrowing capability the binder already needs. Option A keeps the capability and makes it real. An inert mode was not preserved for API cosmetics.
repair_1.root_cause_found_beyond_the_review_state: The binding dataclass did not carry requested_source_universe_ref AT ALL. The binding request recorded it, so it entered the binding-request material, but the constructed binding dropped it. That is why the refinement could not constrain anything at evaluation time: there was no field on the binding to constrain against.
changes: added requested_source_universe_ref as a field on ServiceApplicabilityF8SourceScopeBinding (frozen dataclass) and passed it at the construction site
added private method _require_single_source_binding() which refuses BINDING_MODE_MISMATCH and SINGLE_SOURCE_BINDING_MISSING_REQUESTED_SOURCE rather than silently degrading to the admitted-set check
in assert_query_source_admitted, when binding_mode is SINGLE_SOURCE_VALIDATION, the query source must equal the requested source, checked BEFORE the admitted-set membership check
at bind time, the requested source must also be present in the bound F8 rule's source_universe_refs
the enforced refinement is emitted in the binding material, so it participates in the replay identity
repair_1.ordering_note: The REQUESTED_SOURCE_NOT_ADMITTED refusal was deliberately left PRIMARY. The new rule-scope check was first inserted before that check, which changed the refusal reason for a non-admitted requested source and broke the pre-existing court. The new check was relocated to run AFTER admission, so a non-admitted requested source still refuses with its original, more specific reason.
repair_1.narrowing_law_preserved: A single-source binding may still narrow to a source subset that the EXHAUSTIVE_UNRANKED_SET mode refuses (F8_RULE_SOURCE_SET_NOT_EXHAUSTIVE). Narrowing eligibility is not transformation.
repair_1.authority_effect: Strictly narrowing. Every source evaluable under a single-source binding was already positively admitted, so no unauthorized source became reachable and the repair cannot widen the admitted set.
repair_1.court_witness_for_the_exact_review_case: test_single_source_binding_for_a_REFUSES_evaluation_on_admitted_b -- A and B both positively admitted under one release, F8 rule spanning both, binding made SINGLE_SOURCE_VALIDATION for A, evaluation attempted on B. Under the defect this returned EXACT_SUPPORTED; it now refuses with F8_QUERY_SOURCE_NOT_THE_REQUESTED_SOURCE.

repair_2.review_finding: F2 MEDIUM blocking -- 'the two positive powers, and only two' was false as an API statement
repair_2.why_the_delegating_evaluator_is_not_a_ne: evaluate_bound_positioned_subject_possibility invokes the adopted F8 evaluator UNCHANGED after source-scope validation and grants no selection, ranking, transformation, pooling, currentness, permission or actor semantics of its own. It returns a full F8 result but introduces no power over sources.
repair_2.the_claim_that_remains_exact: There is no THIRD POWER OVER SOURCES. No first/best/latest/local/preferred/ranked/weighted source is obtainable, because no such method exists and all seven selection/permission-shaped methods refuse loudly when attempted.
repair_2.no_third_power_verified_by: recursive value inspection of the emitted binding material for any rank/score/priority/preference/weight/best/first/latest/local leaf, with the negative disclaimer keys pinned and excluded so the scan targets real rank leaves rather than the assertions of their absence.

negative_control_proving_the_court_is_no.method: the repaired binder was replaced by the PRE-REPAIR binder extracted from the exact repair base 8d352f7d80983cbf49e7e57511f8cf6d5b80966d, in a shadow tree outside the repository, and the identical repair court was run against it
negative_control_proving_the_court_is_no.repair_5_witness_separately_controlled: with the pre-repair binding court also restored (5 pytest.skip calls), test_no_write_terrain_guard_in_the_binder_court_skips fails as intended; against the repaired court (0 pytest.skip calls) it passes
negative_control_proving_the_court_is_no.conclusion: Every one of the five repairs has at least one witness that FAILS on the pre-repair code and PASSES on the repaired code. No witness is satisfied by re-running identical inputs.
